data.name: Office Chaos
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO THE COMPANY

You’re the new intern.
The work is simple.
The office is not.

DO YOUR JOB

Answer emails. Deliver paperwork. Fix broken equipment.
These are normal office tasks. You were trained for this.

Unfortunately, everything is on fire.

Tasks pile up quickly, deadlines are tight, and the clock never slows down. Ignore a problem for too long and it escalates.

LEARN FAST

Each workday is a short, high-pressure 8-minute shift where the office actively works against you.

Tiny mistakes turn into big problems.
Big problems turn into total chaos.
And somehow it’s always your fault.

No two workdays are ever the same.

WORK TOGETHER

You’re not alone, and that’s both good and bad.

Office Chaos is built around shared success and shared failure:

  • Play solo or with up to 4 interns online

  • Take on different office roles with unique tools and abilities

  • Share one satisfaction meter, if it hits zero, everyone gets fired

Coordinate, communicate, and improvise..

PHYSICS-BASED OFFICE DISASTERS

The office is fully physical including you.

Carry objects that don’t cooperate.
Trip over coworkers.

Fires, floods, outages, and other “unexpected incidents” will interrupt your plans at the worst possible moments.

This is normal workplace behavior.

FEATURES

  • Survive 8-minute workdays

  • Play 1–4 player online co-op

  • Shared success, shared failure, shared panic

  • Physics-based office disasters

  • Role-based teamwork with unique abilities

  • An office that never stops breaking

Clock in.
Do your best.
Try not to get fired.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-3820 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia 970 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: No Recommendation
  • Additional Notes: Friends to play with
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 9 3900XT or equivalent
  • Graphics: NVidia 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: No Recommendation
  • Additional Notes: Friends to play with
